text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! As I expected, this is tough!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It looks like my clothing wasn't able to withstand my extraordinary skill!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My calculations would attribute the cause to an increase in your weight. Based on your recent calorie intake and your movement velocity, I estimate that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not it! My abilities are just beyond the norm, that's all, so it's not something you can just calculate!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is incorrect. A simple calculation with all values present would serve as proof.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If you won't get the point, let's decide it with a race! The winner is the one who is right!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Exercise would add in more verifiable integers. …Affirmative. Executing verification measures.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the showdown of the two racers unfurled over the course of a few days…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Bourbon! Today will be the day we decide the winner!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All calculations complete… A reduction in weight should have alleviated the feeling of tightness of your uniform.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Now that you mention it, it has felt a bit looser while running these past few days…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see! My uniform has grown! Was it my running that caused it to change?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So I was right after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whatever the reason, Sakura Bakushin O's diet proves to be a success.
